designationHistory.indexText: The refuge established in 1978, under the authority of the Endangered Species Act of 1973 to provide protection for the federally endangered gray and Indiana bats and their crucial habitat consisting of 264 acres of hardwood forest.
designationHistory.note: The refuge page gives only the month or year.
